name: Xian-Zhang Chen
affiliation: Ningbo Institute of Digital Twin & Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo
intro: I study quantum transport and topological quantum devices, with a focus on Majorana modes, magnetic textures, and altermagnets. My research combines analytical modeling with numerical simulations to connect microscopic electronic structure, topology, and experimentally accessible transport signals. My earlier work examined scanning gate microscopy, quantum scars, and many-body spectral statistics in graphene nanostructures.

research.summary: Gate control, proximity effects, and spin-dependent transport in altermagnetic systems.
